name: 4-FPM
summary: Some users report high dosages are needed to feel the effects of this drug

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

pharmacology.en: Like phenmetrazine, it releases dopamine and noradrenaline in the brain, which produces stimulant effects.
pharmacology.zh: 它和芬美曲秦一樣，會促進腦中多巴胺與正腎上腺素的釋放，因而產生興奮作用。
pharmacology.zhHans: 它和芬美曲秦一样，会促进脑中多巴胺与正肾上腺素的释放，因而产生兴奋作用。

uses.en: It has been sold online as a designer stimulant. It has no medical use.
uses.zh: 它曾在網路上作為設計師興奮劑販售，沒有醫療用途。
uses.zhHans: 它曾在网络上作为设计师兴奋剂贩售，没有医疗用途。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Stimulants of this kind can cause a racing heart, raised blood pressure, overheating, loss of appetite, insomnia, anxiety and a strong urge to keep redosing. Serious risks include heart problems, seizures, psychosis and dependence.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。這類興奮劑可能引起心跳急促、血壓升高、體溫過高、食慾不振、失眠、焦慮，以及想一再追加用藥的強烈衝動。嚴重風險包括心臟問題、癲癇發作、精神病與成癮。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。这类兴奋剂可能引起心跳急促、血压升高、体温过高、食欲不振、失眠、焦虑，以及想一再追加用药的强烈冲动。严重风险包括心脏问题、癫痫发作、精神病与成瘾。

fact.en: 4-FPM is a fluorinated version of phenmetrazine, an appetite suppressant sold as Preludin from the 1950s. The Beatles reportedly took Preludin, which they called Prellies, to stay awake during long club nights in Hamburg.
fact.zh: 4-FPM是芬美曲秦（phenmetrazine）的氟化版本。芬美曲秦自1950年代起以Preludin的名稱作為食慾抑制劑販售。據說披頭四在漢堡夜店長時間演出時，曾服用他們稱為「Prellies」的Preludin來保持清醒。
fact.zhHans: 4-FPM是芬美曲秦（phenmetrazine）的氟化版本。芬美曲秦自1950年代起以Preludin的名称作为食欲抑制剂贩售。据说披头四在汉堡夜店长时间演出时，曾服用他们称为「Prellies」的Preludin来保持清醒。
